transcription: You must check out Tokyo's weirdest underground market, not gonna go Broadway. This place has the absolute craziest mix of goods and services you've ever seen all in one place. You'll see dirt cheap full sets of manga right next to Japanese grandmas fighting for discounted fish. You can get $5 used kimonos or Louis Vuitton handbag and a Rolex. You can get a foot massage or go right next door for a full cosplay outfit. Pokemon cards, anime pins and gacha or Persian rugs, model trains, and historic coins. I saw retro video games, vintage toys, and figures from every show movie or game that you can think of right next to American military gear. But I also saw trendy cafes and restaurants, nail salons, and even a bunny themed concept cafe. For the exact same price you can choose between an eight-layer soft-served ice cream or an entire haircut. This five-floor endless maze of hobby shops is a must-see in Tokyo. So save this video for your next trip to Tokyo follow me from OJPAN HACS.
